set -euo pipefail

SECRET_PATTERNS=(
  '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})'
  '(aws_access_key_id|aws_secret_access_key)\s*[=:]\s*.+'
  'secret_key\s*[=:]\s*.+'
  'api[_-]?key\s*[=:]\s*.+'

  'token\s*[=:]\s*[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}'

msg_file="$1"

  exit 1

      echo "ERROR: Body line exceeds 80 chars ($line_len): $line"

set -euo pipefail

DEPLOY_DIR="/var/www/staging"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/git-deploy.log"

while read -r oldrev newrev refname; do
  branch="${refname#refs/heads/}"
  [[ "$branch" != "staging" ]] && continue
  [[ "$newrev" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]] && continue

  wall "Deployed $branch ($commit_hash) to staging at $ts" 2>/dev/null || true

  # Cleanup
  rm -rf "$archive_path" "$tmpdir"

LIMIT=$((50 * 1024 * 1024))

    fi

        PATCH=1
    fi

    CUR_MINOR=${CUR_MINOR:-0}
    CUR_PATCH=${CUR_PATCH:-0}

    if [ "$MAJOR" = 1 ]; then
        NEW_MAJOR=$((CUR_MAJOR + 1))
        NEW_MINOR=0
        NEW_PATCH=0
    elif [ "$MINOR" = 1 ]; then
        NEW_MAJOR=$CUR_MAJOR
        NEW_MINOR=$((CUR_MINOR + 1))
        NEW_PATCH=0
    else
        NEW_MAJOR=$CUR_MAJOR
        NEW_MINOR=$CUR_MINOR
        NEW_PATCH=$((CUR_PATCH + 1))
    fi

    if git rev-parse "$NEW_VERSION" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Tag $NEW_VERSION already exists, skipping"
        exit 0
    fi

    echo "Creating release tag: $NEW_VERSION"

    # Build changelog
    CHANGELOG=$(git log --oneline --no-decorate "${LATEST_TAG:+v$LATEST_TAG}..HEAD" 2>/dev/null)
